item.title: Morgan Stanley's top AI pick has 92% exposure to $1.6 trillion buildout
item.description: The bank calls Nvidia the best risk/reward in AI. Its report outlines what happens to suppliers when a capital cycle turns.

item.title: Anthropic calls human attention the bottleneck in the coming botsitting era
item.description: Claude sessions spend 80% of their time waiting on a person, and the median Anthropic employee spends 20% more time in meetings than a year ago.

item.title: Ukraine's drones lose Starlink above 100 mph; Musk, Rubio, Trump deny role
item.description: Kyiv says a sudden SpaceX speed limit is disabling interceptor drones needed against Russia's jet-powered Shaheds. Musk, the White House, and Trump deny involvement.

item.title: Strategy purchases additional $22 million in Bitcoin, expands share buyback plan
item.description: The purchase is its sixth since August, continuing a buying trend after Bitcoin sales earlier this year.
